operations.title: Finite p-group norm homology is the augmentation ideal modulo the norm line
operations.statement: For every nontrivial finite p-group K over F_p, multiplication by nu_K=sum_g g on F_p[K] has kernel the augmentation ideal I, image F_p nu_K, and square-zero homology I/F_p nu_K of dimension |K|-2. For m regular fibers the dimension is m(|K|-2); C2 is the unique nontrivial acyclic case.
operations.scope: Regular modular group algebra; no physical relative-chain pushforward or physical readout is asserted.

operations.title: Nonabelian order-eight hostile control
operations.procedure: For K=D8 or Q8 over F_2, use x nu_K=epsilon(x)nu_K: kernel dimension 7 and image dimension 1, hence residual norm homology dimension 6 per regular fiber. Contrast K=C2, where the residual dimension is zero.
operations.expected_result: All nontrivial finite p-groups have residual dimension |K|-2; any regular-fiber example with different kernel or image dimensions falsifies the claim.
